caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular patchwork quilt composed of twelve large, circular flower-like shapes arranged in a grid of three rows and four columns. Each circular shape has a central round section surrounded by petal-like extensions, with each flower differing in color and internal pattern. The dominant colors in the petals and centers include reds, browns, beiges, blues, and slightly muted greens, with patterns such as stripes, floral prints, and checks. The background of the quilt is a light, almost off-white color, which provides contrast for the colored shapes. Small blue and green four-petal motifs are distributed in the spaces between the flowers, and there are elongated oval leaf or eye-shaped objects oriented around the outer edge, incorporating green, red, and brown tones. The edges of the quilt are bordered by a narrow patterned strip in reddish color. The overall composition forms a symmetrical, geometric, and colorful layout.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
